title: Port-convention overlay (overlay.toml)
description: Cited per-board overrides applied by sync_port_conventions.py on top of what classify() derives from a constraint file -- polarity (which a QSF cannot express), a pinned primary clock, and vendor-canonical name restorations. Every override carries a cite; that is the whole point of the file, so cite is required everywhere.

name.description: Must match a board row's name in a per-maker registry file (checked by the validator).

clk.description: Pins the board's primary oscillator when classify()'s file-order fallback would pick a wrong clk-shaped name.

then.description: An uncited clock override is exactly the guess this registry exists to prevent.

digit_enable_active_low.description: Scan-style displays only: polarity of the digit-enable (AN-style) lines, read by the native wrapper.

name.description: Restores a vendor-canonical resource name when the rank-1 source project-renamed it.

cite.description: Where this fact comes from. Never cite a board JSON in this repo -- that is circular; cite the vendor document or design that establishes it.
